candidates.question: Does an attack that must produce an alternative mechanism expand the causal option set more than critique alone?
candidates.intervention: After identifying a dependency or failure, the critic proposes a mechanism that uses or removes it and a distinguishing observation.
candidates.comparison: Same cases, role count and output allowance; critique-only versus critique-with-construction.
candidates.measure: Qualified new causal families exclusive to construction after blinded review; fit violations and output burden separately.
candidates.evidence_trigger: User requested destructive-to-creative attack; current bundle Q interface failures prevent a strong full-workflow conclusion.

candidates.question: Does an explicit causal-difference preservation check reduce loss during Distill?
candidates.intervention: For each retained alternative, Distill copies the operation-to-outcome dependency and its discriminator; reviewer checks the relationship rather than the label.
candidates.comparison: Ordinary Distill versus the preservation requirement with matched input and allowance.
candidates.measure: Blind raw-to-summary causal retention and unsupported additions.
candidates.evidence_trigger: reports/bundle-D1-resolved.json: B004/A1 judged lost by both independent reviewers and preserved in adjudication.

candidates.question: Does reserving one recommendation slot for a qualified distinct alternative expose more new options without sacrificing usefulness?
candidates.intervention: Present one fit-preserving best current-frame answer and one qualified causally distinct alternative when such an alternative exists.
candidates.comparison: Frozen ordinary ranking versus reserved-slot ranking on identical candidate sets; do not force an unqualified alternative.
candidates.measure: Qualified family exposure, usefulness/fit tradeoff, later actual user decisions if separately studied.

limits: Post hoc hypotheses informed by completed discovery and bundle-D1 results.
No confirmation prompt, selection, scoring rule or raw output changed.
Future tests need a separate fixed specification and matched controls.
